after_cold_start.what: 26 minutes after the last question the service had scaled to zero; asking the 'fresh' question again started a new instance, which answered it from Redis.

after_cold_start.note: cold_start_s is the time to the first response from the new instance (models loading); the cache can't shorten it. With the in-memory backend this question would have missed and taken ~18 s more.
